categories.main_business_segments: Longfor Group Holdings Limited operates primarily in three main segments: property development, investment property operation, and property service. Property development involves the development and sale of residential, office, and commercial properties mainly in China. Investment property operation includes leasing self-developed or subleased properties such as shopping malls and rental housing to generate rental income and capital appreciation. Property service encompasses property management and entrusted construction services across various property types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs integrated digital technologies and intelligent manufacturing in its smart construction segment, offering one-stop services covering research, design, construction management, and fine engineering. It utilizes digital twin technology, virtual construction, and urban regeneration solutions to enhance operational efficiency and project quality. The property management segment leverages intelligent technology systems for safety, energy conservation, and space maintenance to improve service quality and management efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves residential homebuyers, commercial tenants, and institutional clients across multiple property types including residential housing, shopping malls, offices, serviced apartments, rental housing, hospitals, and elderly care facilities. Its commercial investment targets urban and community shopping centers, while property services cater to homeowners and commercial property users. The customer base spans individual homeowners, retail consumers, corporate tenants, and institutional investors primarily within China.
categories.geographic_coverage: Longfor operates extensively across China, with a presence in over 40 cities including key regions such as the Yangtze River Delta, Pan Bohai Rim, Western China, Southern China, and Central China. Major cities include Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Chongqing, Hangzhou, Wuhan, Xi’an, and others. The Group also has operations in Hong Kong and maintains registered offices in the Cayman Islands. Its land bank and projects are widely distributed across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates primarily midstream and downstream in the real estate supply chain. It develops properties (midstream), manages investment properties and commercial assets (downstream), and provides property management and construction services (downstream). It integrates development, asset management, leasing, and property services to capture value across the property lifecycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the Group focuses on high-quality development, operational resilience, and financial stability. It emphasizes innovation-driven development, digital transformation, and intelligent manufacturing in construction. ESG governance and low-carbon initiatives are core to its strategy, with all new projects meeting national green building standards. The Group prioritizes customer-oriented product iteration, expanding non-development businesses, and enhancing asset management capabilities to drive sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through property sales in the development segment, rental income from investment properties including shopping malls and rental housing, and fees from property management and entrusted construction services. The Group also earns income from asset management operations. Sales revenue is recognized primarily at a point in time, while rental and service incomes are recognized over time.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Longfor positions itself as a leading integrated real estate developer and operator in China with a diversified portfolio across development, commercial investment, asset management, and property services. It holds a strong market presence in tier-1 and tier-2 cities, with industry-leading scale in rental housing and high occupancy rates in commercial properties, reflecting competitive operational capabilities and strategic asset allocation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported total revenue of RMB127.5 billion and a core net profit attributable to owners of approximately RMB7.0 billion. It delivered about 100,000 housing units across 43 cities with a 90% customer satisfaction rate. The Group’s land bank totaled 33.12 million sqm with an attributable area of 24.26 million sqm. It reduced interest-bearing debt by RMB16.3 billion to RMB176.3 billion, lowered average finance cost to 4.0%, and maintained a net debt to equity ratio of 51.7%, demonstrating a stable financial position amid industry adjustments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longfor emphasizes high-quality, customer-centric residential products that are safe, comfortable, green, and intelligent, meeting diverse living needs. Its commercial properties focus on vibrant, high-quality consumer spaces with strong occupancy and rental growth. The Group’s integrated asset management and smart construction capabilities provide comprehensive, efficient, and innovative solutions that enhance asset value and operational efficiency. Its commitment to ESG and digital transformation further differentiates its sustainable and forward-looking business model.
